vectors.name: transformChunks null attribution preservation > preserves a continuation's null subagentRunId for enforcement to reject
vectors.spec: /spec/1.0/events/subagents#attribution: an absent subagentRunId means the parent agent and MUST NOT be spelled as null
vectors.notes: wrapped: RUN_STARTED prepended (TS test drove transformChunks alone). DIVERGES from the isolated-stage assertion: the TS test fed transformChunks alone and asserted the second CONTENT keeps subagentRunId: null. On the canonical pipeline the compatibility boundary reads an event-level subagentRunId: null as absent, removes it and warns ('Converting deprecated subagentRunId: null to an absent field', once per run), so the run is ACCEPTED and neither CONTENT carries the key.
